description: Defines a template class StreamJSONType for JSON stream serialization/deserialization with nested serializer and deserializer implementations, handling JSON and MessagePack formats, and managing data flow over a communication channel.

classes.name: StreamJSONType
classes.description: Template class managing JSON stream serialization/deserialization with nested serializer/deserializer classes, handling communication over a channel.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles queuing and serialization of outgoing JSON messages.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming JSON messages.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: Wraps the source interface to provide send/receive data and state change notifications.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns reference to the communication channel.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle received messages.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send messages.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state changes.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an element for transmission if the channel is open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the communication channel with a wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the communication channel with a wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if serializer and deserializer are idle.
